topics.name: Generated Documentation
topics.purpose: Define deterministic generation of human documentation, indexes, Topic views, relation maps, help and other derived documentation from the canonical graph.

semantics.generation_rule: Generated documentation reads canonical semantics through the generic recursive reader.
semantics.determinism_rule: Same canonical graph plus same generator version/config produces semantically equivalent documentation.
semantics.source_ref_rule: Generated sections retain canonical source refs where useful for traceability.
semantics.nonauthority_rule: Generated output is derived_projection source role.
semantics.edit_rule: Machine-significant edits must be made to canonical source semantics, not only to generated output.
semantics.staleness_rule: Stale generated output is detectable by source/generator metadata or regeneration comparison.

invariants.rule: Documentation, diagrams, serializers and projection tools derive from canonical semantics and never become semantic authority by convenience.

hard_gates.condition: generated document treated as semantic definition
manual edit to generated output becomes sole machine-significant change
generated output drops source traceability where required
stale generated docs silently presented as current canonical truth
